# README images

## Promotional illustration

`product-hero.svg` is a static vector export of the original project homepage illustration from [FieldIllustration.tsx](../../web/src/FieldIllustration.tsx), [pen-path.ts](../../web/src/pen-path.ts), and [BrandWordmark.tsx](../../web/src/BrandWordmark.tsx). It has a transparent canvas, adapts its ink colors to light/dark mode, and keeps the Chinese captions in both README languages. The illustration and wordmark are paths, with no embedded screenshot, external font request or script. The two caption lines use system font fallbacks, so their appearance may vary by device.

The wordmark outlines come from the bundled JasonHandwriting6p font under [SIL OFL 1.1](../../web/public/fonts/OFL-JasonHandwriting.txt). Original project illustration code retains the project license. This asset was exported from the project source; it was not generated in ChatGPT. The earlier PNG was a user-supplied screenshot crop and has been superseded.

## Product screenshots

Captured from the running what-the-repo development UI in Microsoft Edge on 2026-09-13. The example analyzes the public repository [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), snapshot c291e7961a51.

- dsh-learning.jpg: a real four-step learning route and the understanding check from its first guided explanation. The demonstration conversation was created for this README.
- dsh-component.jpg: the task orchestration layer with the session task-list component selected, related connections emphasized and unrelated nodes faded. Captured as a viewport-region screenshot.

These are genuine captures, not mockups. Account details and earlier conversations are outside the captured view. No pixels or product text were rewritten. The example uses Chinese content in both language editions of the README.

The screenshots depict original project UI and generated explanations about DSH. Referenced upstream names, paths and code remain attributable to their respective owners; the project's MIT license does not relicense third-party material. Existing UI font/icon notices are recorded in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

The linked images from [Shields.io](https://shields.io/) are navigation labels and a link to the project's MIT license. They do not represent awards, certification or a passing CI run.
